gui.the_emerald_standard.tooltip.banking: Move money along one clearly labeled route. Only Bank Cash can be withdrawn or invested.
Open and manage certificates of deposit separately from Savings and villager loans.
Fund and collect villager loans separately from Savings and CDs. Lending can lose principal, but never creates player debt.
Inventory is physical emerald items. Bank Cash is spendable and withdrawable. Savings earns interest, but must first transfer back to Bank Cash before withdrawal or investment.
Bank Cash is available to spend. Total CDs is locked certificate value across all positions. Open New CD always takes the selected amount from Bank Cash.
Bank Cash is available to spend. Total loans is the current value across villager-loan positions. New loans always take the selected amount from Bank Cash.
